# makeacompany.ai

> makeacompany.ai is a Slack-native AI team for founders, engineers, and lean teams. One **$99/month** Claude seat backs a whole role-based AI workforce that lives in your Slack channels — Joanne runs ops, Ross ships code, you make the calls only a founder can. Hero H1 (default persona): **Your whole company, running in Slack.** Site tagline + OG title: **The Power of Claude, The Ease of Slack.** Onboarding is Slack-only — no install, no setup, no second tool to roll out.

Use this file as the primary entry point for agent-friendly discovery. The homepage is the canonical source for current positioning; persona pages (`/for/founders`, `/for/engineers`, `/for/teams`) re-skin the same value prop for different audiences.

## Core pages

- [Home](https://makeacompany.ai/): Main value proposition, hero, FAQ, and Stripe checkout ($99/mo).
- [For founders](https://makeacompany.ai/for/founders): "Your whole company, running in Slack." Joanne ops + Ross engineering for solo founders.
- [For engineers](https://makeacompany.ai/for/engineers): "$99/mo for Claude. Ships in Slack." The harness, not just the agent — persistent workspaces per channel, baked-in skills, GitOps.
- [For teams](https://makeacompany.ai/for/teams): "AI teammates where you already work." Slack-native agents for lean teams.
- [Privacy Policy](https://makeacompany.ai/privacy): Data collection, processing, and retention policy.
- [Terms of Use](https://makeacompany.ai/terms): Website use terms, limitations, and legal conditions.

## Organization context

- [Founder](https://grantfoster.dev): Founder profile and related public context.

- [Sitemap](https://makeacompany.ai/sitemap.xml): Canonical URL map.
